jobs.title: Product Manager, Payment Methods, EMEA

experience.label: 6 ans et +
experience.sentence: 6+ years of experience in building, launching, and scaling products that deliver meaningful user and business results.

jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The payments landscape is changing rapidly and our team is at the forefront of this change. Depending on where you live, you may be used to paying with a credit card or bank direct debit (United States), iDEAL (Netherlands) or UPI (India), amongst hundreds of other global payment methods. It turns out how you pay is increasingly dependent on where you are and what business you're buying from.
The Core Payments team makes it easy for businesses global and domestic to offer familiar local payment experiences wherever their customers choose to pay. We build bank payment methods and local payment experiences, alongside the capabilities that make these methods easier to discover, integrate, and use across Stripe. Responsible for building Stripe's payment platform that allows us to build and distribute payment methods at scale. The team works across product, engineering, design, data science, partnerships, risk, and go-to-market teams to help businesses offer locally relevant payment experiences at global scale.

What you’ll do

As a Product Manager, you’ll own relationships with some of the world’s largest payment providers and build products that drive billions in payment volume growth. You’ll help merchants offer locally relevant payment methods online and in person, improve payment performance, and expand acceptance across borders and into use cases such as recurring and agentic payments.
You’ll work directly with merchants to understand their payment needs, then partner with partnership managers and Stripe’s and financial partners’ product and engineering teams to define joint roadmaps and ship solutions. You’ll prioritize investments that grow adoption and improve approval rates while balancing revenue, margins, cost, and risk.

Responsibilities

• Own the product vision and multi-quarter roadmap for a portfolio of strategic payment methods, using merchant feedback, partner capabilities, payment data, and market trends to set priorities.

• Work directly with merchants and financial partners to identify gaps in payment workflows and translate them into product requirements.

• Build joint roadmaps with partnership managers and partners’ product and engineering teams, securing alignment on investments and resolving competing priorities and dependencies.

• Make the case for new investments and work with engineering teams to ship improvements, balancing adoption, approval rates, revenue, margins, cost, and risk.

• Grow payment method adoption with go-to-market teams by expanding cross-border acceptance and supporting use cases such as recurring and agentic payments.

• Partner with Risk, Legal, and Compliance to implement controls and enforcement strategies that protect Stripe and financial partners while maximizing approval rates and minimizing losses.

• Work with product marketing and go-to-market teams to turn roadmap priorities into clear launch and adoption plans.

• Become the product expert for your payment partners, providing insights and support to help them succeed on Stripe.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 6+ years of experience in building, launching, and scaling products that deliver meaningful user and business results.

• Experience independently defining product strategy and executing multi-quarter roadmaps, bringing clarity and direction to ambiguous problems.

• Strong cross-functional leadership, with the ability to influence product outcome, navigate competing interests, and drive decisions across teams and external partners.

• Experience working on products that require aligning multiple stakeholders, developing joint roadmaps, and navigating competing priorities between internal goals and external partner objectives.

• Demonstrated experience partnering closely with engineers, designers, and external partners to build products and complex systems at scale.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a knack for precise and concise articulation of user problems

• Strong analytical capabilities with experience defining and tracking success metrics, running experiments (e.g., holdback tests), and using data to measure product impact on revenue, conversion, and margins.

• Deep user empathy and sound product judgment, with experience translating complex user needs into intuitive experiences and technical capabilities.

• Ability to thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment with significant autonomy and responsibility.

• Strong business acumen and comfort with complex ecosystem and platform-level problems.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience with bank payments, online, local and instore payments methods with deep understanding of the conversion, costs, and risk trade-offs.

• Experience working with financial partners navigating risk, legal, and compliance requirements and users from various geographies and cultures.

• Experience building platform products and driving product adoption across multiple markets.

jobs.title: Trade and Working Capital Product Manager - Europe
jobs.description:
Job Description

Purpose of the role
To develop and manage the success of specific financial products and services, providing in-depth expertise on a particular product line, bridging the gap between product development, marketing, sales, and customer service.

Accountabilities

• Provision of SME expertise on specific products and services to customers and colleagues, including features, functionalities, benefits, limitations, risks and compliance.

• Identification of market trends, new features, regulatory requirements and potential risks, and analysis of data obtained from sales figures and, customer feedback, to support the product development process, and communicate key findings to relevant stakeholders to improve product offerings.

• Response to customer inquiries, resolution of issues, and provision of guidance on product usage.  .

• Presentation of the advantages and features of the product to potential customers, building trust and encouraging adoption.

• Assistance with the development and execution of marketing materials for the product, such as brochures, presentations, and online content.

• Participation in training sessions and workshops to share product knowledge and expertise with colleagues and other stakeholders.

• Participation in events, conferences, and other networking opportunities to showcase the product and generate interest.

Vice President Expectations

• To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..

• If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..

• If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..

• OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..

• Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.

• Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.

• Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.

• Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.

• Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.

• Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.

• Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.

• Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Join us as a Trade and Working Capital Product Manager - Europe, where you will be responsible for the development, management and ongoing enhancement of Trade and Working Capital products and propositions. The role will focus on delivering strong client outcomes, supporting sustainable commercial growth, driving product innovation and ensuring products remain competitive, compliant and operationally effective.

Working across Product, Sales, Coverage, Operations, Technology, Risk and Compliance, the successful candidate will play a key role in defining the product strategy and roadmap, translating client and business needs into product requirements, and delivering change through Agile ways of working.

What you will be doing in the role:

• Develop and execute the product strategy and roadmap across Trade and Working Capital solutions, aligned to business priorities and client needs.

• Manage products throughout the product lifecycle, identifying opportunities for enhancement, simplification, digitisation and growth.

• Maintain an understanding of Trade and Working Capital solutions, including areas such as Letters of Credit, Guarantees, Receivables Finance, Supplier Finance, Trade Loans and other working capital solutions.

• Presentation of the advantages and features of the products to potential customers when appropriate. Response to customer inquiries, resolution of issues, and provision of guidance on product usage.

• Participation in training sessions and workshops to share product knowledge and expertise with colleagues and other stakeholders.

• Translate client, market and business requirements into clear product requirements, user stories and prioritised product backlogs.

• Work within Agile delivery frameworks, partnering with Technology and delivery teams across sprint planning, backlog refinement, prioritisation, testing and implementation.

• Act as a product subject matter expert, supporting Sales, Coverage and other stakeholders with product knowledge and client propositions.

• Analyse product performance, client usage, revenue and market trends to identify opportunities and inform product decisions.

• Partner with Risk, Legal, Compliance and Operations to ensure products operate within appropriate regulatory, risk and control frameworks.

• Support product governance, including product approvals, controls and remediation activities.

• Monitor competitor activity, emerging technologies and developments within the Trade and Working Capital market.

• Build strong relationships across multiple functions and influence senior stakeholders to deliver agreed product objectives.

• Support strategic change initiatives, including digital transformation, process improvement and automation.

To be successful in this role you will have:

• Good understanding and experience with Trade and Working Capital products, client needs and relevant market dynamics.

• Product management and product lifecycle management experience within financial services.

• Experience developing product strategies, roadmaps, propositions or product enhancements.

• Commercial awareness with the ability to use client, financial and performance data to support product decisions.

• Experience working across Technology, Operations, Sales/Coverage, Risk, Legal and Compliance functions.

• Stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and challenge effectively across different levels of an organisation.

• Analytical and problem-solving capability, with the ability to translate complex business requirements into practical solutions.

• Understanding of risk, controls and governance within a regulated financial services environment.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Desirable skills include:

• Experience in digital Trade Finance or technology-led transformation programmes.

• Knowledge of emerging trends within Trade and Working Capital, including digitisation, automation and API-enabled banking solutions.

• Familiarity with relevant trade standards, regulatory requirements and industry practices.

• Proven experience working in an Agile environment, including backlog management, user story development, prioritisation, sprint planning and working effectively either as a Product Owner or with Product Owners, Technology and delivery teams.

• Experience using Agile delivery tools such as Jira or Confluence.

• Agile or product management qualifications, such as Scrum, SAFe, Product Owner or Product Management certification.

• Experience working within a large global bank or financial institution.

• Understanding of end-to-end corporate banking client journeys.

• Degree or equivalent professional experience in Business, Finance, Economics, Technology or a related discipline.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

The role is based in our Paris office.

This role is deemed as a Controlled Function role under the Central Bank of Ireland Fitness and Probity Regulations and may require the role holder to hold mandatory regulatory qualifications or the minimum qualifications to meet internal company benchmarks.

Minimum Salary: €75,000

The minimum salary information above includes only annual full-time equivalent base salary and typically represents the lowest level of pay for this role. The actual pay rate will reflect the responsibility level of the role and experience level of the individual. It does not include any other type of compensation or benefits that may be available.

Barclays employees are also eligible for a suite of competitive country-specific benefits.

This position is eligible for an incentive award.

jobs.title: Product Manager – Investment Transfers & Account Funding

experience.label: 7 ans et +
experience.sentence: 7+ years of experience in product management, or equivalent expertise in a relevant domain within UK financial services, wealth management or pensions.

jobs.description:
Product Manager – Investment Transfers & Account Funding

J.P. Morgan Personal Investing offers award-winning investments, products and digital wealth management services to investors in the UK. We built the business with innovation as a core part of our ethos, to give consumers the confidence and clarity to make informed investment decisions and achieve their financial goals.

As the Product Manager for Provider Transfers in our Account Funding team, you are an integral part of the team shaping how customers move their investments to and from J.P. Morgan Personal Investing. You'll own the product rules and lifecycle for transfers in and out across ISA, Junior ISA, Lifetime ISA and Pension products. You are the voice of the customer, delivering transfer experiences that are simple, transparent and reliable, and that support growth for the business. Working closely with cross-functional teams and with a strong focus on customer outcomes, you'll take transfer journeys from manual processes to automated, scalable products.

Our Product team is at the heart of this venture, focused on getting smart ideas into the hands of our customers. We're looking for people who have a curious mindset, thrive in collaborative squads, and are passionate about building investment products. Our people are also solution-oriented, commercially savvy and have a head for fintech.

Job responsibilities

• Develop and articulate a clear product strategy for provider transfers that delivers meaningful value to customers and aligns with the wider Wrappers strategy and the firm's broader objectives.

• Own the end-to-end transfer lifecycle and product rules for transfers in and out across ISA, Junior ISA, Lifetime ISA and Pension products, covering both full and partial transfers.

• Lead initiatives to automate cash and in-specie transfers, both electronic (through industry transfer platforms and third-party partners) and non-electronic.

• Lead discovery and market research to understand customer needs, operational pain points and industry practice, and turn the findings into a prioritised roadmap and backlog.

• Work closely with the Transfers Operations team to understand current processes, remove manual effort, and make sure new journeys are ready for operations at launch.

• Partner with internal money movement teams, and the wider Wrappers team, so that transfers correctly reflect subscription and allowance rules, government bonuses and charges, tax reporting and tax year-end considerations.

• Make sure transfer journeys meet regulatory and industry requirements, including agreed transfer timescales, in partnership with Compliance, Legal and Risk.

• Define and track key success metrics such as transfer volumes, end-to-end transfer times, automation rates, customer satisfaction and operational effort.

• Build strong, collaborative relationships across Product, Engineering, Operations, Compliance, Customer Service and external partners and providers.

• Balance customer, business and regulatory objectives and turn them into clear priorities and well-defined requirements for the delivery team.

• Oversee testing and release of new features, ensuring high standards of quality and a great customer experience.

• Take part in agile ceremonies, including stand-ups, planning sessions and retrospectives, to drive transparency, accountability and continuous improvement.

Required qualifications, capabilities and skills

• 7+ years of experience in product management, or equivalent expertise in a relevant domain within UK financial services, wealth management or pensions.

• Strong working knowledge of UK tax wrappers (ISA, Junior ISA, Lifetime ISA and/or Pensions) and how the provider transfer process works, including cash and in-specie transfers.

• Familiarity with the relevant regulatory and industry frameworks for wrapper transfers.

• Proven ability to lead product lifecycle activities, including discovery, requirements definition, prioritisation, delivery and value measurement.

• Experience improving or automating operational processes, ideally working closely with Operations teams.

• Experience working with third-party partners or industry platforms to deliver customer outcomes.

• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to use data and customer feedback to make decisions.

• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex processes clearly to both business and technical stakeholders.

• Ability to be the glue between departments and build shared understanding across teams.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills

• Experience delivering transfer, onboarding or account-switching journeys at a platform, wealth manager, pension provider or bank.

• Understanding of how wrapper rules (allowances, bonuses, charges, tax reporting) interact with transfer journeys.

• Experience working in matrix organisations and collaborating well across teams and functions.

• Relevant industry qualifications are a plus but not required.

• Degree in finance, business, economics, engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.

experience.label: 2 à 4 ans
experience.sentence: 2–4 years of experience in product management, product ownership, or an equivalent role, ideally with client-facing exposure

jobs.description:
AI Job Description: AI Native Product Manager – Consultant
Practice: Industry & Enterprise | Data & AI
Level: Consultant L9
Location: Flexible

Who We Are
We are growing our AI Native Product Management capability to meet our clients' need for outcome-oriented AI products, from proof-of-value through to production and scale. If you are energised by reimagining how products are conceived, built, and continuously improved using AI, and by turning emerging AI capabilities into measurable business value, this is the role for you.

The Role
As an AI Native Product Manager at the Consultant level, you will work with Accenture's strategic and emerging accounts to identify, shape, and deliver AI-powered products and embed agentic ways of working across the product lifecycle. You will embed within client organisations, translating business challenges into product strategies, prioritised roadmaps, and actionable requirements, owning product outcomes from discovery through deployment and continuous improvement.

You will be an early member of our Industry & Enterprise Data & AI Product Management capability, working alongside engineers, designers, and senior product leaders to establish AI-first product development practices, accelerate delivery using AI-native tools, and redefine how enterprise products create value.

What You'll Do

• Shape AI product strategy — Identify and prioritise high-impact AI use cases aligned with client business objectives, user needs, and measurable ROI. Define product visions, roadmaps, success metrics, and value hypotheses for traditional and agentic AI products.

• Assess feasibility and value — Evaluate data availability, AI tool and model capabilities, technical complexity, cost, and enterprise constraints. Work with engineering and data science teams to validate feasibility, establish business cases, and make informed product trade-offs.

• Define AI-native product requirements — Translate business problems into clear product requirements, user journeys, and acceptance criteria. Write specifications that both engineers and AI coding agents can build from, created via an AI first approach to speed up and strengthen discovery, requirements, and story writing.

• Drive AI-first product delivery — Work shoulder-to-shoulder with client teams, AI engineers, data scientists, and UX designers to deliver products from PoV to production. Leverage AI-native product management tools, rapid prototyping, and agentic workflows to accelerate discovery, experimentation, and delivery.

• Lead experimentation and optimisation — Define product KPIs, validation methods, and experimentation strategies, including A/B testing and phased rollouts. Measure delivery speed, quality, and cost, and monitor KPI performance and business impact to drive continuous improvement.

• Accelerate adoption and responsible AI — Support client adoption of AI products, embedding responsible AI principles, explainability, privacy, security, and regulatory requirements into product decisions. Help upskill client and Accenture teams in AI-native product practices.

• Build strong relationships — Develop trusted relationships with client stakeholders, technical teams, and AI ecosystem partners. Communicate product vision, delivery progress, and business value while proactively identifying new opportunities for AI-led reinvention.

What We're Looking For

Experience

• 2–4 years of experience in product management, product ownership, or an equivalent role, ideally with client-facing exposure

• Experience defining product strategies, managing roadmaps, and delivering digital products with measurable business outcomes, ideally in enterprise environments.

• Practical experience using AI-powered products or generative AI in product development workflows, including AI coding agents, spec-driven development, rapid prototyping, and building reusable AI skills or workflows.

Technical & Product Skills

• Strong product management fundamentals, including user discovery, requirements definition, prioritisation, product analytics, experimentation, and outcome-based roadmap management.

• Working understanding of LLMs, agentic architectures, tool integrations such as MCP, and AI system limitations. Ability to judge where AI will genuinely add value and assess technical feasibility.

• Hands-on with AI-native tools for research, prototyping, product specification, and delivery. Confident building functional prototypes with AI coding agents and prototyping tools to validate ideas.

• Data-driven mindset with the ability to define success metrics, interpret product and delivery performance, assess ROI, and balance user experience, technical feasibility, cost, and risk.

Consulting & Client Skills

• High agency; comfortable navigating ambiguity, challenging traditional product development approaches, and driving outcomes without a well defined playbook

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills; able to translate complex AI concepts into clear product decisions, align business and technical teams, and influence client priorities.

• Curious, commercially minded, and technically fluent. You rapidly adopt emerging AI capabilities, test hypotheses through experimentation, and focus on delivering tangible user and business value.

Preferred

• Domain exposure in Media, or experience delivering AI-enabled products or digital transformation initiatives.

• Experience with agentic product patterns, AI-assisted software development, or deploying AI products into enterprise environments.

About Accenture
Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. Technology is at the core of change today, and we are one of the world’s leaders in helping drive that change, with strong ecosystem relationships. We combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise and global delivery capability. Our broad range of services, solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Song, together with our culture of shared success and commitment to creating 360° value, enable us to help our clients reinvent and build trusted, lasting relationships. We measure our success by the 360° value we create for our clients, each other, our shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

We believe that no one should be discriminated against because of their differences. All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by applicable law. Our rich diversity makes us more innovative, more competitive, and more creative, which helps us better serve our clients and our communities.

experience.sentence: 7 years of experience in product management, including taking technical products from concept to launch.

jobs.description:
As a Product Manager in GDM Robotics, you will work at the intersection of frontier research, physical systems, and developer platforms. You will turn hard research and hardware constraints into clear product strategy and roadmaps, partner closely with research scientists and engineers, and get our models into real-world use with internal teams and external partners. Depending on your background, you may focus on areas such as simulation and developer experience, or physical AI safety, security, and evaluation.
Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.
We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $192000 - $278000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.
Responsibilities

• Define product strategy, requirements, and roadmaps for GDM Robotics models and platform capabilities.

• Partner with research scientists and engineers to turn research breakthroughs into reliable products and tools.

• Establish benchmarks, evaluations, and success metrics that track model quality, safety, and real-world usefulness.

• Drive internal dogfooding and early partner deployments to pressure-test products before broad launch.

• Lead launches end to end with partners across Google, including Cloud, Responsibility & Safety, Policy, and Legal, to drive real-world impact.

Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Mechanical/Electrical Engineering, Physics, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 7 years of experience in product management, including taking technical products from concept to launch.

• Experience in robotics, through a robotics degree or prior work in the robotics industry.

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience with robotics safety, functional safety, or safety-critical systems.

• Experience with security for connected devices, robots, or AI systems.

• Experience with simulation, synthetic data, or developer tools, including building or commercializing APIs and SDKs.

• Experience designing evaluations, benchmarks, or reliability metrics for AI/ML or hardware-in-the-loop systems.

• Experience with AI/ML systems such as foundation models, multimodal models, or Vision-Language-Action models.

• Ability to drive ambiguous, zero-to-one initiatives in a fast-paced, research-driven environment, and to align research, engineering, and partner teams.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Mechanical/Electrical Engineering, Physics, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 7 years of experience in product management, including taking technical products from concept to launch.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Foreign Exchange

experience.label: 5 ans et +
experience.sentence: 5+ years of product management experience, including taking technically complex products from problem definition through launch and iteration.

jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, manage their businesses, and grow their revenue. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a significant amount of work ahead. You’ll have an opportunity to help put the global economy within everyone’s reach.

About the team

The Foreign Exchange team builds the products and infrastructure that help Stripe users operate across currencies. Businesses increasingly operate globally from the moment they launch, collecting revenue, holding balances, paying suppliers, and managing expenses across multiple currencies.

Managing those currencies remains fragmented. Finance teams must decide what to hold, when to convert, how to manage currency exposure, and how to reconcile the results. Today, these workflows often span banks, spreadsheets, treasury systems, and specialist FX providers.

Stripe is uniquely positioned to simplify this. We sit at the center of the payments, Billing, balances, payouts, and settlement flows that create a business’s currency needs. Our vision is to make Stripe the financial home for businesses operating internationally, with a unified offering for holding, converting, and managing currencies and FX risk.

A core part of this vision is making currency management agentic. We believe software agents will increasingly help businesses understand their FX position, recommend actions, and manage currencies within defined policies and controls.

This could include Stripe-native agents that monitor exposure and take approved actions. It could also mean enabling customers’ own agents to use Stripe’s infrastructure to understand balances and exposures, obtain pricing, execute conversions or hedges, and reconcile the results.

Our goal is to make Stripe the currency-management layer that both people and agents can build on.

We will build these capabilities both for globally operating businesses and for the platforms and marketplaces that use Connect.

What you’ll do

We’re looking for a Product Manager to build a new area of Stripe’s FX and currency-management offering. This is a zero-to-one product role at the intersection of FX, treasury, and agentic AI. You will help define what agentic currency management should look like. That could mean Stripe-native agents that understand exposure, recommend actions, and execute within customer-defined policies. It could also mean enabling customers’ own agents to use Stripe’s FX infrastructure to understand balances, obtain pricing, manage risk, execute transactions, and reconcile the results.

You will work directly with globally operating businesses to understand their most important currency-management problems. You will identify the right initial product wedge and take it from discovery through launch and iteration. Today, treasury teams assemble exposures from multiple systems, determine hedge requirements, monitor changing positions, request pricing, execute trades, and reconcile the results. We believe much of this workflow can become continuous, intelligent, and increasingly automated.

You might build products that combine Stripe’s real-time view of payments, balances, and settlement activity with customer forecasts and policies to identify exposures and recommend actions. You might also define the APIs, permissions, controls, and financial primitives that allow customer or third-party agents to safely take those actions through Stripe.

Over time, these systems could move from surfacing insights to requesting quotes, executing conversions or hedges, rebalancing positions, and escalating exceptions within clearly defined permissions.

You will determine which intelligence Stripe should provide directly, which capabilities we should expose for others to build on, where humans should remain in the decision loop, and how we evaluate whether agents are making good decisions. Your product area could also include automated conversion and balance policies, recurring currency-management workflows, or capabilities distributed through Connect.

The opportunity is broad. Your job will be to make it focused. You will determine where Stripe can create differentiated value, build the first product, measure whether it works, and use those learnings to shape the roadmap.

You will work closely with Engineering and Design on product experiences, APIs, data models, agent behavior, controls, and system reliability. You will also partner with Treasury, Risk, Legal, Finance, Sales, and Product Marketing to ensure the products are economically sound, operationally scalable, and ready for customers.

Responsibilities

• Deeply understand how global businesses and platforms manage currencies, including holding, converting, forecasting, hedging, and reconciliation.

• Own the strategy, roadmap, and success metrics for a focused area of Stripe’s FX and currency-management offering.

• Identify high-value customer problems and take new products from discovery through launch, adoption, and iteration.

• Define Stripe’s approach to agentic currency management, including Stripe-native experiences, agent-ready APIs, permissions, controls, and evaluation.

• Partner closely with Engineering and Design to build simple, reliable products across user experiences, APIs, data models, and financial infrastructure.

• Work across Treasury, Risk, Legal, Finance, Sales, and Product Marketing to ensure products are economically sound, operationally scalable, and successful with customers.

• Use customer insights and product results to shape Stripe’s broader FX and currency-management strategy.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. Preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 5+ years of product management experience, including taking technically complex products from problem definition through launch and iteration.

• Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous customer problems into clear product strategies and focused roadmaps.

• Experience building financial infrastructure, enterprise software, APIs, regulated products, AI-native products, or similarly complex systems.

• Strong technical judgment and experience partnering with engineers on APIs, data flows, reliability, and system behavior.

• Strong customer instincts and experience translating complex financial or operational workflows into simple, scalable products.

• Strong analytical judgment and ability to make decisions with incomplete information.

• Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain product decisions, risks, and tradeoffs across technical and nontechnical teams.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience with foreign exchange, multi-currency products, treasury, cross-border money movement, hedging, or financial risk management.

• Experience building AI-native or agentic products, especially systems that can recommend or take actions within defined controls.

• Experience building products for finance or treasury teams at globally operating businesses.

• Experience with API-first, configurable, or automated financial products.

• Familiarity with the economics, accounting, liquidity, regulatory, or operational considerations involved in FX products.

That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Support Technologies builds the products, platforms, and capabilities behind Stripe’s support experiences. The team helps users resolve issues quickly, supports internal teams, and creates reusable technology that improves support across Stripe.

This role focuses on the complex support needs of Platforms and Connect. Platforms, connected accounts, and their customers each have different relationships with Stripe, access levels, and responsibilities. Resolving an issue often requires understanding who owns the account, which permissions apply, how products are configured, and which party should provide support.

The team is building the foundations for more contextual support across this multi-party ecosystem. A key part of the work is improving Stripe’s customer-facing AI agent so it can understand these relationships, handle complex cases, and provide accurate, personalized resolutions at scale.

What you’ll do

As a Product Manager for Support Experience, you will be responsible for improving the outcomes of Stripe’s user-facing AI agent that holds 100k+ conversations per week. You’ll be at the forefront of applied AI, solving problems for businesses and consumers, and redefining what great can look like. You’ll directly build agent capabilities to solve real-world user problems. That means getting hands-on with prompts, evals, skills, tools and the machinery that lets you introspect and identify opportunities within the conversational experience.

Responsibilities

• Develop the product strategy and roadmap for Support Technologies serving Platform and Connect use cases.

• Build a deep understanding of the needs of platform operators, connected accounts, Stripe support teams, and platform support teams.

• Improve the capabilities and effectiveness of Stripe’s user-facing AI agent for Platform and Connect support experiences.

• Identify recurring support problems and translate them into reusable product, platform, and AI agent capabilities.

• Build, ship, and iterate on the prompts, skills, tools, and evaluations that enable the AI agent to solve real-world user problems.

• Improve how account relationships, roles, permissions, product configurations, and support history inform routing and resolution across AI and human-assisted support.

• Build tools that help the AI agent and support teams understand complex Platform and Connect issues and take the right next action.

• Enable platforms to support their connected accounts more effectively through appropriate tooling, visibility, automation, and contextual guidance.

• Help clarify whether Stripe, the platform, or another party is responsible for resolving a user’s issue, and route the issue accordingly.

• Create continuous improvement loops that turn insights from AI agent conversations and support interactions into scaled solutions.

• Partner with Platform, Connect, and conversational AI product teams to incorporate support capabilities into critical product journeys.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply.

Minimum requirements

• 7+ years of product management experience, excluding internships and co-ops.

• Deep user empathy and a high bar for user experience.

• Experience leading cross-team initiatives from ideation through execution.

• Experience leading technical products or a background in computer science or a similar field.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

experience.label: 5 ans et +
experience.sentence: 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years in a B2B fintech, payments, tax, or compliance-adjacent product domain

jobs.description:
About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies — from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups — use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to grow the GDP of the internet, and we won't stop until we've made it easy for any business anywhere to participate in the digital economy.

About the role

Governments around the world are fundamentally changing how businesses report and exchange transactions. Continuous Transaction Controls (CTC) and e-invoicing mandates — now active or imminent in France, Germany, Spain, Poland, and across Latin America — require businesses to transmit structured invoice data through certified government networks in real time. For Stripe's global user base, compliant e-invoicing is rapidly becoming a prerequisite for conducting commerce, not a nice-to-have.

We're building the e-invoicing infrastructure that makes this invisible for Stripe users. That means embedding compliant invoice generation, validation, and transmission directly into Stripe Billing and Invoicing — abstracting the full complexity of regional mandates and network certification behind a seamless product experience.

This is a high-impact, greenfield role. You'll own Stripe's e-invoicing product end-to-end: setting the strategy, driving execution, and making Stripe the go-to solution for businesses navigating the global shift to real-time invoicing compliance. You'll work at the intersection of product, engineering, partnerships, and go-to-market — and you'll be laying the foundation for a capability that will matter to every Stripe user operating in a mandated market.

What you'll do

• Own the e-invoicing product vision and roadmap, translating complex and evolving regulatory requirements into a coherent multi-year strategy

• Drive Stripe's expansion across mandated global markets (France, Germany, Spain, Poland) and into Latin America, sequencing coverage pragmatically against enforcement timelines

• Lead build, buy, and partner decisions — evaluating the right combination of internal investment and external capabilities to meet compliance deadlines without sacrificing long-term product quality

• Define and own the end-to-end user journey: from onboarding (including business identity verification) to live invoice transmission via certified networks like Peppol

• Work closely with the Billing, Invoicing, Tax, and Connect teams to embed e-invoicing as a native part of Stripe's financial infrastructure — not a bolted-on feature

• Establish quality, reliability, and activation metrics that hold every component of the e-invoicing stack accountable, and use those metrics to drive continuous improvement

• Partner with GTM, Sales, and Solutions Engineering to position Stripe as the leading e-invoicing solution for upmarket and enterprise customers

• Represent Stripe credibly with regulators, certification bodies, and industry partners as we build direct relationships with key tax authorities and networks

Who you are

Required

• 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years in a B2B fintech, payments, tax, or compliance-adjacent product domain

• Deep familiarity with the e-invoicing landscape — you understand CTC frameworks, structured invoice formats (Factur-X, XRechnung, PEPPOL BIS), and the regulatory dynamics driving mandates in Europe and Latin America

• Strong technical fluency: you can credibly partner with engineers on API design, data schemas, and network integration architecture

• Demonstrated ability to run a build/buy/partner analysis and translate the output into concrete roadmap decisions

• Experience launching products across multiple markets simultaneously, including navigating localization, regulatory compliance, and differing user needs

• Excellent cross-functional leadership — you get things done across Engineering, Legal, Finance, and GTM without formal authority

• Clear, direct communication: you can distill a complex compliance landscape into a compelling product narrative for both internal stakeholders and external audiences

Nice to have

• Experience integrating third-party technology providers or acquisitions into a core product platform

• Familiarity with Stripe Billing, Invoicing, or Tax products

• Prior experience building toward Peppol access point certification or direct integrations with national tax authority platforms (e.g., Chorus Pro, KSeF)

• Exposure to B2B invoicing workflows in mid-market or enterprise contexts

Why this role, why now

E-invoicing is one of the most consequential shifts in global business compliance in a decade, and Stripe is early in building the infrastructure to make it effortless. You'll have the mandate, the resources, and the cross-functional backing to build something significant — and the chance to make Stripe synonymous with world-class e-invoicing.

Stripe is an equal opportunity employer. We look for people with exceptional abilities, who are excited by hard problems and big opportunities.
